author: Cleo Abram
description:
This is a drawing of a modern animal…. if you drew it the way many early science illustrators drew dinosaurs. 

They just drew skin wrapped around bone without muscle, turning this normal animal into a monster. Can you guess what it is?

This is called “shrink wrapping” and it has affected the way a lot of us think about what dinosaurs looked like…

If you want to know more about dinosaurs, watch our longer video! And subscribe for optimistic science and tech stories… 

#shorts #animation #illustration #dinosaur #science #stemfacts
title: Can You Guess This Animal?
